entities.name: Graaz
entities.description: A Juggernaut on New Phyrexia, one of Memnarch's levelers that still wanders the surface of Mirrex tearing through everything in its path.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The one who created Mirrodin's levelers, later deposed.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane that absorbed many levelers.

events.summary: Memnarch is deposed, leaving the levelers to wander confused and leaderless; many are captured and absorbed into New Phyrexia but Graaz remains.
events.quote: When he was deposed, they were left to wander the land, confused and leaderless.

relations.quote: created by Memnarch to wreak terror across the plane at his behest
